profile.name: OpenPLC 上传配置工具
profile.description: 用于配置并上传 OpenPLC 相关参数的非实体图形工具，提供网络、端口、Modbus 与 I/O 选项的界面，实验中可用于准备控制逻辑部署和通信设置。
profile.description_en: A non-physical graphical utility for configuring and uploading OpenPLC-related settings. It provides interfaces for network, port, Modbus, and I/O options, and is used in labs to prepare control-logic deployment and communication settings.

registry.name: Uploader
registry.description: Uploader驱动，支持hide ioconfig/init ui/load config/on close/on combo等38个操作。
